source_text: Homo secundum ordinem suum et secundum signa sua castra collocent. Signa — proprietates quibus unusquisque designatur, etiam in animis: alius mitis, alius turbidus. Unusquisque secundum signa sua incedat; aemulatione a inferioribus ad meliora signa venire possumus. In resurrectione stella a stella differt in gloria.
pass_a_gloss: Man according-to order his and according-to signs his camps let-them-pitch. Signs — properties by-which each is-designated, also in souls: one mild, other turbulent. Each according-to signs his let-him-advance; by-emulation from lower to better signs to-come we-can. In resurrection star from star differs in glory.
pass_b_english: [[Each man according to his order and according to his signs shall pitch camp >> Bible:Numbers 2:2]]. “Signs” are the marks that name each person — and each soul: one mild, another stormy. Let each walk by his signs; by zeal we can move from lesser signs to greater. In the resurrection [[star differs from star in glory >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:41]].
